spec.description: Kubernetes node, workload and persistent volume health and utilization.

spec.title: Pods based CPU usage
spec.description: Shows CPU usage per pod, based on the amount of Cores in use

spec.expr: topk(15, sum by (namespace, pod, container) (rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{image!="", container!="", container!="POD", namespace=~"$k8s_namespace"}[5m])))
topk(15, sum by (namespace, pod, container) (container_memory_working_set_bytes{container!="", container!="POD", namespace=~"$k8s_namespace"}))

spec.title: Volume status
spec.description:
Status for each volume.

A status of 'Pending' usually means something is wrong with either the volume configuration.

spec.expr:
(
  max by (persistentvolumeclaim, namespace) (kubelet_volume_stats_used_bytes{namespace=~"${k8s_namespace}"})
  /
  max by (persistentvolumeclaim, namespace) (kubelet_volume_stats_capacity_bytes{namespace=~"${k8s_namespace}"})
) * 100

spec.title: All Running PVCs Used Bytes
spec.description:
Used Bytes by running PVCs.

Keep in mind that in AHD VM all locally hosted PVCs show the used disk space of the entire VM.

spec.title: Journal volume (24h)
spec.description: Number of system journal records received during the last 24 hours. No data may mean the journal source is disabled or has no entries.

spec.title: System errors by service (24h)
spec.description: System journal entries classified as err or crit, grouped by systemd unit.

spec.expr: sum by (component) (count_over_time({job="systemd-journal", level=~"err|crit"} !~ "ContainerStatus from runtime service failed|failed to read (cpu|memory)[.]max|is not as new as written version"[24h]))

spec.title: Recent system error logs
spec.description: Error and critical journal entries in the dashboard's selected time range.

spec.expr: {job="systemd-journal", level=~"err|crit"} !~ "ContainerStatus from runtime service failed|failed to read (cpu|memory)[.]max|is not as new as written version"
